create_VideoManager: create a VideoManager instance with a config to read frames from a webcam or video file for inference
iterate_VideoManager_next: iterate over a VideoManager to read sequential clips of frames as TaskInfo objects for model inference
display_VideoManager: display visualized frames from a TaskInfo object to a window or write them to an output video file
create_ThreadVideoManager: create a ThreadVideoManager instance with a config to read and write video frames using multithreading for inference
start_ThreadVideoManager: start the read and display threads of a ThreadVideoManager for concurrent frame grabbing and output writing
